data.name: Hotel Le Rotabas
data.address: Pointe de la Caravelle, Durivage, Sainte-Anne 97180, Guadeloupe
data.description:
This breezy hotel with a tropical vibe is a minute's walk from the waterfront and 5 minutes from Caravelle Beach. Pointe-à-Pitre International Airport is 21 km away.
The airy, relaxed rooms feature Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and pull-out sofas. Colorful bungalows add terraces with private gardens; some have kitchenettes.
A breakfast buffet is served in a casual restaurant. There's also a snack bar with a terrace, as well as an outdoor pool. Parking is available.
